P101_DE_VIB_RMS.source_signal: bearing 1 (failed, outer race), channel 1, RMS of each 1 s snapshot
P101_DE_VIB_RMS.transform: S1: mean of ~4.1 snapshots per replay hour x 36.29 (healthy median -> 2.8 mm/s). S2: first 100 healthy hours repeated.

P101_BRG_TEMP.source_signal: none: IMS has no temperature channel
P101_BRG_TEMP.transform: 58 + 2.2 x max(0, vib - 2.8), first-order lag tau 3 h, N(0, 0.3) noise, seed 100

P101B_DE_VIB_RMS.transform: hourly mean x 36.12 (healthy median -> 2.0 mm/s); first 100 healthy hours repeated in both scenarios, because the rig's shared shaft couples the failing bearing into bearing 4

FI201_REFLUX_FLOW.source_signal: XMEAS14: Separator underflow, rescaled to reflux flow. S1 from d00_te.dat (normal), S2 from d05_te.dat (IDV 5)
FI201_REFLUX_FLOW.transform: 20.0 + (x - normal mean) x 0.8; 4 samples (12 min) averaged per replay hour

LI201_V201_LEVEL.source_signal: XMEAS12: Separator level, kept in %. S1 from d00_te.dat (normal), S2 from d05_te.dat (IDV 5)
LI201_V201_LEVEL.transform: 50.0 + (x - normal mean) x 1.0; 4 samples (12 min) averaged per replay hour

PI201_V201_PRESS.source_signal: XMEAS13: Separator pressure kPa, rescaled to barg. S1 from d00_te.dat (normal), S2 from d05_te.dat (IDV 5)
PI201_V201_PRESS.transform: 1.8 + (x - normal mean) x 0.01; 4 samples (12 min) averaged per replay hour

TI301_CW_OUT.source_signal: XMEAS22: Separator cooling-water outlet temperature, rescaled. S1 from d00_te.dat (normal), S2 from d05_te.dat (IDV 5)
TI301_CW_OUT.transform: 35.0 + (x - normal mean) x 2.0; 4 samples (12 min) averaged per replay hour

TV301_POS.source_signal: XMV11: Condenser cooling-water flow valve, rescaled to position %. S1 from d00_te.dat (normal), S2 from d05_te.dat (IDV 5)
TV301_POS.transform: 55.0 + (x - normal mean) x 4.0; 4 samples (12 min) averaged per replay hour
